briefing: I'm {PATRON}, and I run things here at {HERE}.
A canister broke loose from the rail and drifted one jump out, and I want it back.
Scoop it up, bring it home to {HERE}, and I will make it worth your time.

find.arrive: Scoop the canister adrift at {TARGET} for {PAY}
find.success: Scoop complete at {TARGET}, and {PAY} draws closer
find.fail: The canister at {TARGET} is gone, and {PAY} is lost

home.arrive: Bring the canister back to {TARGET} for {PAY}
home.fail: The run to {TARGET} failed, and {PAY} is lost

dossier.lead: Word reached the commander that {PATRON} wanted her attention at {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Some traders say {PATRON} at {WORLD} lost a canister worth chasing.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sent word from {WORLD}, asking after the missing canister.

dossier.news: {PATRON} at {WORLD} has work waiting for a pilot who can scoop and haul.

story.opening: The commander took on a recovery job at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the commander delivered the canister to {WORLD}, and the job was complete.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the canister never reached {WORLD}, and the mission failed.

find.success: On day {DAY}, the commander scooped the canister near {WORLD}.
find.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, something destroyed the canister near {WORLD} before the commander could scoop it.
find.failed: On day {DAY}, the search near {WORLD} failed, and the canister stayed lost.

home.success: On day {DAY}, the commander delivered the canister to {WORLD}.
home.failed: On day {DAY}, the return to {WORLD} failed, and the canister never arrived.

dossier.title: The Drifting Canister
